identity.pick: What is the secret identity of {label}?
identity.match: Match each hero to their secret identity.

rows.label: Spider-Man
rows.hook: was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko and is among the most popular superheroes ever

rows.label: Doctor Doom
rows.hook: is a Marvel supervillain created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby, one of the company's most used villains

rows.label: Batman
rows.hook: is a DC hero created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane who is a wealthy industrialist in Gotham City

rows.label: Martian Manhunter
rows.description: fictional superhero that appears in DC Comics' publications

rows.label: Superman
rows.description: superhero appearing in DC Comics publications
rows.hook: is the archetypal superhero, created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster for Action Comics

rows.label: Captain America
rows.hook: was created by Joe Simon and Jack Kirby as a frail man rejected by the army who is enhanced to peak human form

rows.label: Scarlet Witch
rows.hook: is a Marvel mutant who manipulates probability and later becomes a sorceress wielding chaos magic

rows.label: Deadpool
rows.hook: first appeared as a supervillain in The New Mutants before starring in his own solo comics

rows.label: Iron Man
rows.hook: is a founding member of the Avengers, co-created by Stan Lee and Larry Lieber

rows.label: Wonder Woman
rows.description: superhero appearing in DC Comics publications and related media
rows.hook: is a DC heroine created by psychologist William Moulton Marston in All Star Comics

rows.label: Harley Quinn
rows.hook: began as the Joker's henchwoman in an animated series before becoming a recurring favorite

rows.label: Catwoman
rows.description: fictional character associated with DC Comics' Batman franchise
rows.hook: is Batman's best-known love interest and one of his most prominent enemies

rows.label: Storm
rows.hook: is a powerful X-Men mutant who can control the weather and atmosphere

rows.label: Zorro
rows.hook: is a dashing masked vigilante who defends the common people of old California

rows.label: Daredevil
rows.hook: is one of the best-known blind superheroes in American comics, with enhanced senses

rows.label: Riddler
rows.description: fictional character, a comic book supervillain who appears in comic books published by DC Comics

rows.label: Two-Face
rows.description: villain in the DC Comics universe
rows.hook: is one of Batman's most enduring enemies, a supervillain in his rogues gallery

rows.label: Aquaman
rows.hook: is a DC hero and founding member of the Justice League who debuted in More Fun Comics

rows.label: Poison Ivy
rows.description: fictional character throughout the DC Universe

rows.label: Black Panther
rows.hook: is the king and protector of Wakanda, a high-tech nation built on vibranium

rows.label: Penguin
rows.description: supervillain appearing in DC Comics publications and related media
rows.hook: is one of Batman's most enduring enemies and often named among his best villains

rows.label: Doctor Octopus
rows.hook: is a myopic, stocky mad scientist with four strong tentacle-like limbs, created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko

rows.label: Green Goblin
rows.description: name used by numerous fictional characters in Marvel Comics
rows.hook: is one of Spider-Man's principal archenemies, a persona born of chemically induced insanity

rows.label: Green Arrow
rows.hook: is a DC archer hero who debuted in the same comic issue as Aquaman

rows.label: Lone Ranger
rows.hook: is a masked lawman who fought outlaws in the Old West alongside his friend Tonto

rows.label: Mr. Freeze
rows.description: fictional character throughout the DC Universe
rows.hook: is an ice-themed Batman enemy who must live in sub-zero temperatures

rows.label: Nightwing
rows.hook: is the grown-up hero identity taken by Batman's first Robin, who went on to lead the Teen Titans
